usedFor: Zoom holds meetings, and Google Docs logs “When a meeting summary is completed” through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a meeting summary is completed” in Zoom, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: The finished summary lands in a doc tab, so notes sit beside the plan.

watchOut: “When a participant joins a meeting” fires for each person, so the doc can be written many times.
